name: orca-dot-bridge
description: Set up and operate a local Orca bridge for GitHub Projects intake and optional Slack approval workflows.

interface.longDescription: Choose when the Orca coordinator opens and closes, then configure GitHub Projects intake on your Mac. The local bridge reads eligible issues from a chosen board, waits for an Orca acknowledgment, and can write an intake comment and project status when explicitly applied. Optional Slack approval relay and read-only worker canaries require separate setup. Requires Python 3.9 or newer, a running local Orca installation, and the GitHub CLI for intake. GitHub batch intake and draft pull requests are off in the example configuration. This is a community integration.
defaultPrompt: Show me the coordinator session options.
Set up on-demand sessions for my local Orca bridge.
